title: Parts order arrived
description: Tell customers that ordered auto parts have arrived and are ready for installation. Utility WhatsApp template for shops and dealers.
notes: Reference the order and part name; follow up with an installation slot via a quick reply.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, the *{{part}}* you ordered (order {{order}}) has arrived. We can install it this week. Pick a day that works for you.
